channel.title: AI Changelog
channel.description: New AI and data science papers, repos, models, tools and news.

item.title: [news] Token fraud is here and it’s BAD (YouTube)
item.description: Token fraud is here and it’s BAD (YouTube) Claire Vo runs ChatPRD , an AI platform that helps product managers "turn an idea into a spec". The product has been live since the GPT-4 era, and Claire has been building it in public for much of that time.

item.title: [news] Amazon SageMaker Inference: 2026 launches in review, part 2
item.description: This second installment reviews 13 more Amazon SageMaker AI inference launches from 2026, spanning configuration recommendations, fitting more models onto each GPU, serving models too large for one instance, cross-Region routing, and post-launch tuning, bringing the year's…

item.title: [news] Use Kimi Code CLI with models on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Kimi Code CLI v2.7.0 adds a native Amazon Bedrock provider to connect coding agents to models using standard AWS credentials.

item.title: [news] Gemini 4 Neon is the new #1 on the Models Engineering Index
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from git-aarvin.github.io. 335 points and 209 comments.

item.title: [news] Enable AI agents to pay for AWS Marketplace x402 products with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments
item.description: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore payments enables AI agents to purchase AWS Marketplace products and pay directly through developer AWS bills.

item.title: [news] How the BMW Group governs hundreds of agents across thousands of developers
item.description: When hundreds of agents serve thousands of developers, governance cannot be an afterthought. The BMW Group shares the practices and patterns its R&D teams use to build, govern, and operate AI agents at enterprise scale without sacrificing speed, quality, or compliance.

item.title: [news] Run your whole selling business in AWS Quick
item.description: Most sellers do not need another AI product to learn. They need the tools and information they already use brought together, so they can see what is happening in their business and act on it.

item.title: [news] Amazon SageMaker AI now detects latency drift, idle GPUs, and missed optimizations on your inference endpoints
item.description: Amazon SageMaker AI now monitors your generative AI inference endpoints by default and tells you when a change could improve performance or lower cost.

item.title: [news] Inside Amazon Connect Talent: The science of structured AI interviews
item.description: For organizations hiring hundreds or thousands of people, every interview presents the same challenge: How do you give candidates a consistent opportunity to demonstrate their skills while gathering the evidence needed to make informed hiring decisions?

item.title: [news] PostgreSQL 19 Released
item.description: PostgreSQL 19 Released Most years PostgreSQL ships a new release in September, but this year's release came two months later thanks mainly to the flurry of issues that the PostgreSQL team needed to address as part of the ongoing AI-reported vulnerability apocalypse.

item.title: [paper] Posterior Matching Distillation
item.description: Posterior Matching Distillation trains a stochastic student to match a teacher diffusion model’s full posterior via tilted mean constraints, enabling high-quality few-step image generation without auxiliary score networks.

item.title: [paper] RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
item.description: Research paper proposing a fixed set of steering vectors to approximate reinforcement learning post-training in diffusion transformers without input-dependent transformations.

item.title: [paper] PlayCraft: Designing Engaging Games from Agent Play Experience
item.description: PlayCraft uses a vision-based player agent and a crafter agent to iteratively revise games, improving player learning gains and slopes across intelligence settings.

item.title: [paper] TideCache: Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving with Transparent Cache Management and Layer-Wise Streaming
item.description: Research paper presenting TideCache, a hybrid language model serving system that improves latency and agent turns through transparent cache management and layer-wise streaming.

item.title: [paper] One Prior, Two Dynamics: Repurposing Video Diffusion Transformers for Self-Supervised Latent Action Learning
item.description: Research paper introducing O2LaF, a framework that repurposes pretrained video generators into inverse and forward dynamics models for self-supervised latent action learning.

item.title: [paper] ScaleWorld: High-Resolution World Generation through Shared Prediction and Refinement
item.description: Research paper introducing ScaleWorld, a causal video model that unifies low-resolution world prediction and high-resolution refinement within a single shared backbone.

item.title: [paper] AgentRoboCritic: Understanding the Capability of Frontier Agents on Direct Robot Control
item.description: Research paper presenting AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework and dataset for action-level analysis of frontier models in direct robot control.

item.title: [paper] Variants of Beam Search for DiskANN
item.description: Research paper presenting variants of beam search and a beam predictor to reduce query latency in disk-based approximate nearest-neighbor search graphs.

item.title: [paper] Bio-PM-Guided Synthetic IMU Generation
item.description: Research paper exploring bio-signal encoder guidance to generate synthetic inertial measurement unit tokens for improving human activity recognition classification.

item.title: [paper] Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
item.description: A single scalable network estimates dense metric depth for images and video at native resolution, jointly improving metric accuracy, boundary sharpness, and temporal consistency.

item.title: [paper] SoK: Assessing the Evolution of LLM Capability in Software Vulnerability Research
item.description: Research paper establishing an evaluation framework and systematizing published evidence on the evolving capability of large language models in software vulnerability research.

item.title: [paper] Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
item.description: Research paper proposing OracleImitator, an active feature acquisition method that uses soft-target imitation to distill an explicit oracle teacher into a deployable policy.

item.title: [paper] PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
item.description: Research paper presenting Physically Grounded Execution, a framework that decomposes long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation into state machine control, VLA skills, and spatial consistency components.

item.title: [paper] Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
item.description: A task-adaptive agentic framework utilizes 3D proxies, physics simulation, and multi-agent coordination to enhance the structural control, physical plausibility, and visual realism of generated videos.

item.title: [paper] Realized versus Population Reliability: Anytime-Valid Self-Consistency Certification under Correlated Reasoning
item.description: Self-consistency certification framework that accounts for correlated reasoning streams to guarantee proper finite-sample error control when evaluating language models.

item.title: [news] Should governments slow frontier AI? Jacob Coxon and Robin Hanson debate [video]
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from youtube.com. 100 points and 198 comments.

item.title: [paper] Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
item.description: Multimodal Concept Lens framework that maps intermediate states to a shared semantic space to study concept accessibility and reasoning in vision-language models.

item.title: [paper] Verify the Verifier: Specification-Grounded LLM Cross-Checking for Bugs That Escape UVM Scoreboards
item.description: Verify the Verifier framework that uses an LLM-based anomaly cross-checker to detect specification-violating bugs that escape hardware verification scoreboards.

item.title: [paper] ProtoDiffusion: Token-per-Layer Generative Modeling of Multi-Layer Images
item.description: ProtoDiffusion latent-diffusion framework that represents graphic design layers compactly using a shared spatial prototype and candidate vectors for generation and reconstruction.

item.title: [paper] Represented but misread: Post-training changes how language models read out what they represent
item.description: Analysis of how post-training changes language model readout mechanisms, improving the extraction of represented truths while reducing answer sensitivity for specific classification tasks.

item.title: [paper] Text-Aware, Vision-Blind: How Multimodal Image Editing Systems Handle Unsafe Inputs
item.description: EditSafetyBench benchmark that evaluates the safety awareness of multimodal image editing systems, revealing a systematic text-vision safety mismatch during unsafe inputs.

item.title: [paper] GEOHunter: Mapping a Generative Engine Optimization Network in the Wild
item.description: Network measurement study that tracks generative engine optimization services across user-generated-content platforms and evaluates their influence on search outputs.

item.title: [paper] Multi-institutional grading of Barrett's esophagus dysplasia without stain normalization using a pathology foundation model and multiple instance learning
item.description: Foundation model-based deep learning system that accurately grades Barrett's esophagus dysplasia across multiple institutions without requiring stain normalization.

item.title: [paper] MM-SystemOneBias: Evaluating Bias in Multimodal Jev-Style System One Decision Models
item.description: MM-SystemOneBias evaluation suite that assesses stability and decision-interface biases in multimodal decision models under various presentation changes.

item.title: [paper] Replication of Agentic Security Events: Audit and Investigation (ROGUE-AI)
item.description: ROGUE-AI multi-agent framework that replicates reported agentic security incidents offline to investigate root causes and validate real-world failures.

item.title: [paper] The Geometry of Lies: Knowledge and Persona Directions for Detecting Deception in Large Language Models
item.description: Method using persona and knowledge directions in large language models to detect lies and distinguish them from honest denials across various benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
item.description: Audio-driven streaming avatar system called AURA that generates high-resolution talking-head videos chunk by chunk with low latency using a rolling KV cache.

item.title: [paper] LLM GerryMandering: Separating Interactions from Additive Effects in LLM Audits
item.description: Additive Intersectional Screen method that detects intersectional bias in language models by scoring subgroups using additive residual distances from a fitted additive model.

item.title: [paper] Cost-Aware Agentic Feature Optimization System for Fleet-Scale Ranking Models
item.description: Agentic feature optimization system that automatically selects and tunes features for large-scale ranking models under strict pipeline cost and throughput constraints.

item.title: [paper] Backtracking Agent Applications Security Incidents
item.description: Backtracking tool called Origin that uses a cross-layer dependency graph to map high-level agent trajectory logs to low-level code execution vulnerabilities during security incidents.

item.title: [paper] Deterministic Temporal Embedding for Calcium Imaging Trace Extraction
item.description: Deterministic temporal embedding framework that maps pixel-wise fluorescence traces to a low-dimensional space for extracting calcium-dependent cellular activity traces without stochastic negative sampling.

item.title: [paper] The Window Lever: Longer Observation Windows Outweigh the Observed Effects of Data, Capacity, and Architecture in Customer Behavior Forecasting
item.description: Customer behavior forecasting study showing that longer observation windows significantly outweigh the performance impacts of additional data, model capacity, and newer architectures.

item.title: [paper] Plan4D: Generative Plannable 4D Worlds
item.description: Generative 4D world model called Plan4D that predicts future RGB videos alongside dense geometry, depth, and scene flow from observed scenes and text-specified actions.

item.title: [paper] Simple Private Noisy SGD is Minimax-Optimal under Population Strong Convexity
item.description: Research proving that standard differentially private Noisy SGD achieves minimax-optimal parameter estimation error for smooth and strongly convex losses.

item.title: [paper] Hybrid Retrieval for Government Scheme Search in English and Marathi
item.description: Bilingual search system for government schemes in English and Marathi that combines lexical BM25 retrieval with sentence-embedding similarity to improve search relevance.

item.title: [paper] Direct3D-V3: Latent-Free Diffusion Transformers in the Native Voxel Domain
item.description: Direct3D-V3 proposes a latent-free diffusion transformer framework operating directly in the native voxel domain to generate 3D shapes with richer local detail.

item.title: [paper] AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
item.description: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification.

item.title: [paper] GLiDE: A Fast, Calibrated Decision Model Distilled from Reasoning Teachers
item.description: GLiDE is a family of decision models distilled from reasoning teachers that enables fast, confidence-aware single-pass inference without generating intermediate text.

item.title: [paper] Visual Attribution Limits and Graded Provenance Auditing in Commercial Video-Generation APIs
item.description: A graded audit combines passive attribution and cryptographic provenance to evaluate commercial video-generation APIs and verify tier and model claims.

item.title: [paper] Grid Cells as Spectral Successor Features: A Reusable Basis for Continual Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Grid Cells as Spectral Successor Features builds a reusable basis from eigenvectors of a transition matrix to enable efficient continual reinforcement learning without replay buffers.

item.title: [paper] SGAR: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction via Sparse Geometry-Guided Attention
item.description: SGAR is a sparse geometry-guided attention method for feed-fast 3D reconstruction that replaces dense global attention with efficient cross-view proximity token selection.

item.title: [paper] Multimodal Error Detection in Chest X-ray Reports: A Large Language Model Reading Image Evidence
item.description: Rad-Linter is a fine-tuned language model that reads chest X-ray image evidence scores to accurately detect potential errors and inconsistencies in radiology reports.

item.title: [paper] FLUID: Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance
item.description: FLUID is a unified framework for situated task guidance that evaluates and enables flexible, evidence-grounded human-AI interactions with appropriate timing.

item.title: [paper] SHUSH: Emission-Aware Reward Design for Proactive Video Assistants
item.description: SHUSH introduces an emission-aware F1 reward for proactive video assistants to prevent over-emission and improve response timing and content accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Anticipating Future Build Results with BuildPredictor
item.description: BuildPredictor is a random forest model that anticipates continuous integration build outcomes using source, complexity, and historical features to save computational resources.

item.title: [paper] A new algorithmic approach for finding flat minima: critically damped Polyak stepsizes
item.description: Critically damped Polyak stepsizes introduce an adaptive stepsize rule for gradient descent that biases optimization toward flatter minima and reduces sharpness.

item.title: [paper] Monte Carlo Pass Search for Setpieces
item.description: Monte Carlo Pass Search is a simulation-based method for evaluating and optimizing soccer set pieces using 3D ball physics and generative player models.

item.title: [paper] Neural Conditional Gaussian Model: Efficient Data Assimilation with Sequential Uncertainty Quantification for Nonlinear Dynamics
item.description: Neural Conditional Gaussian Model is a data-driven dynamical model that uses a learned latent space with conditional Gaussian structures for efficient data assimilation and uncertainty quantification.

item.title: [paper] Bayesian optimization on amortized search space
item.description: Bayesian optimization on amortized search space uses an amortized inverse map of a mechanistic simulator to restrict the search space and improve optimization efficiency in real-world problems.

item.title: [paper] Fixing the Last Mile: Failure-Aware Image Restoration with Region-Specific Guidance
item.description: Failure-Aware Image Restoration is a region-bound conditioning approach that addresses localized failures in image restoration by applying targeted corrective guidance to specific areas.

item.title: [paper] A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
item.description: Zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives compile deterministic computation circuits directly into pretrained language model weights without altering natural-language competence or requiring training examples.

item.title: [paper] Scaling classical hardware for accurate real-time quantum error correction
item.description: Rapids is a streaming neural decoder co-designed with an FPGA to process quantum error correction syndrome measurements with low latency and high accuracy.

item.title: [paper] Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
item.description: A diagnostic benchmark of 180 simulated manipulation configurations evaluates whether embodied systems can combine history-based reasoning, precise execution, and closed-loop environmental feedback, revealing that single-view competence does not transfer to composed tasks.

item.title: [paper] Should Belgians Install an Advanced Energy Management System in Their Electrified Dwelling ?
item.description: Study on advanced energy management systems in Belgian dwellings evaluates model predictive control and machine learning strategies to optimize electrified heating and vehicle charging costs.

item.title: [paper] Learning to Defer under Expert Drift
item.description: Expert-Drift-Adapted Learning-to-Defer is a framework that models temporal shifts in human expert reliability using a sequence model to improve human-AI task allocation over time.

item.title: [paper] Risk-Controlled Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
item.description: R2-VLA is a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented framework that uses uncertainty prediction to manage test-time adaptation and expert assistance in vision-language-action models.

item.title: [paper] Asuka-FM: A System-Architectural Co-Design Framework for Efficient Text-to-Image Pretraining on Consumer Hardware
item.description: Asuka-FM is a system and architectural co-design framework that enables efficient pretraining of text-to-image diffusion transformers from scratch on a single consumer GPU.

item.title: [paper] HumanCOIN: A 12,500-Hour Dataset for Human Intent in Egocentric Manipulation
item.description: HumanCOIN is a 12,500-hour first-person manipulation dataset featuring gaze, exertion, and cognition proxies to study human intent in physical tasks.

item.title: [paper] AdaPixFlow: Learning Continuous-Time 3D Dynamics Across Scenes from Sparse Multi-view Observations
item.description: AdaPixFlow is a learning method that uses multi-view RGB-D observations to predict continuous-time 3D object motion across different scenes without per-scene optimization.

item.title: [paper] FFGaussType: Feed-Forward Conversion of Glyph and SVG Geometry into Compact Gaussian Assets
item.description: FFGaussType is a feed-forward model that converts glyph and SVG outlines into compact neural Gaussian assets in a single forward pass for 3D graphics.

item.title: [paper] MemFolder: Structure-Guided Memory Folding for Efficient Agent Memory Management
item.description: MemFolder is a memory management framework that uses record structure and context folding to reduce record counts and context lengths for long-term AI agents.

item.title: [paper] Exact Bayesian layers via characteristic functions
item.description: CF-Prop is an uncertainty propagation method using characteristic functions to compute exact output distributions for Bayesian ReLU layers without sampling.

item.title: [paper] Seer: Guiding Small Deep-Research Agents with Shared Decision Models
item.description: Seer is an inference-time framework that uses offline-trained simulators and value estimators to guide small on-device deep-research agents without extra tool calls.

item.title: [paper] Reasoning-Trace Analysis Using Large Language Models for Interpretable Q-Matrix Construction
item.description: Reasoning-Trace Analysis uses large language models and chain-of-thought prompting to generate, compare, and inspect attribute-labeled reasoning steps for Q-matrix construction.

item.title: [paper] Awaken-HI: Scaling Humanoid Intelligence with Whole-Body Human Experience
item.description: Awaken-HI is a vision-language-action model trained on paired egocentric video and whole-body human motion data to improve humanoid loco-manipulation tasks.

item.title: [paper] FEA solver integration of a composite World Model with a Spiking Neural Network memory Block for computationally efficient modelling of defects and variabilities
item.description: This composite World Model integrates a spiking neural network memory block with transformer blocks to efficiently model material defects and structural variations in real time.

item.title: [paper] ZeroVLN: Learning to Navigate without Supervised Fine-Tuning of the VLM Brain
item.description: ZeroVLN is a slow-fast vision-language navigation framework that avoids navigation-domain supervised fine-tuning of the VLM brain by using a semantic tool-calling interface and closed-loop reinforcement learning to coordinate a language-based brain with an action expert,…

item.title: [paper] Sequential Anytime Valid Tests for Efficient Inference-Time Alignment
item.description: e-RWSC is an anytime-valid stopping method using betting supermartingales to efficiently halt generation during inference-time model alignment while bounding error probabilities.

item.title: [paper] How to Effectively Manage the Energy in Residential Systems: Development and Comparison of Methods
item.description: The TreeC machine learning method learns understandable and efficient residential energy management strategies that perform competitively with model predictive control and reinforcement learning.

item.title: [paper] Statistical Inference with Ill-Conditioned Random Weight Neural Network Sieves
item.description: A theoretical analysis of random weight neural network sieves reveals that their covariance matrix eigenvalues diminish as dimension grows, and establishes new approximation, estimation, and inference guarantees.

item.title: [paper] WeMM-Video: Pushing the Frontiers of Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding
item.description: WeMM-Video is a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models that unify text, image, audio, and video processing for joint audio-visual perception and reasoning, using hybrid thinking modes and large-scale training to achieve strong open-source video…

item.title: [paper] Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
item.description: Edit-Ready Training prepares vision models for direct weight-space programming by large language models, significantly increasing editing success rates across various vision tasks.

item.title: [news] Chrome AI features wasting much bandwidth
item.description: Chrome AI features running by default can consume significant bandwidth and data usage over time if left enabled.

item.title: [paper] Flow Matching from Non-Gaussian Sources: A Theory of Efficient Sampling
item.description: A nonasymptotic convergence theory for Euler-discretized flow matching with non-Gaussian source distributions establishes finite-step sampling guarantees and total variation error bounds.

item.title: [paper] TacInno: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models the Contact Dynamics Beyond Vision and Action
item.description: TacInno isolates contact dynamics that cannot be explained by vision and actions alone, using this tactile innovation as a training target to improve visuo-lateral-action model manipulation success rates.

item.title: [paper] Democratizing Cross-Project Knowledge for Transforming Water Governance and Climate Resilience: an Agentic AI Ecosystem
item.description: An Agentic AI Ecosystem combines heterogeneous water governance project documentation into a domain-aware knowledge base and uses an adaptive retrieval-augmented generation pipeline to improve information retrieval.

item.title: [news] AI isn't replacing your job. It's turning it into low-paid gig work
item.description: Trending on Hacker News from restofworld.org. 133 points and 66 comments.

item.title: [paper] Simulation-pretrained autoencoders versus PCA for compressing multimode fibre transmission matrices
item.description: A simulation-pretrained autoencoder compresses multimode fibre transmission matrices and provides a reliable prior when few or no real transmission matrix measurements exist.

item.title: [paper] ViDecide: Teaching Video Diffusion Models to Reason and Plan Step by Step
item.description: ViDecide trains video diffusion models as decision-centric reasoners and planners that predict state transitions causally and use corrective fine-tuning to achieve high success rates on planning tasks.

item.title: [paper] GateTrace: Where Do Crowd Crossings Go Missing Under Occlusion?
item.description: GateTrace derives reference crossings from pedestrian annotations and traces missed crowd crossings under occlusion to help evaluate pedestrian tracking systems.

item.title: [paper] SEEC: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Self-Supervised External-Eye Representation Learning
item.description: The Standardized External-Eye Corpus provides a 4.35-million-image dataset and benchmark for evaluating self-supervised external-eye representation learning across anatomical and clinical tasks.

item.title: [paper] A Complete Geometric Message-Passing Architecture for Point Clouds
item.description: Geometric message-passing architecture for point clouds that uses a novel equivariant design to achieve completeness without high-order representations or intensive tests.

item.title: [paper] Evidence from a Multi-Regime Causal Discovery Benchmark: UCMT Algorithms, Comparative Performance, and Controlled Ablation Studies
item.description: Causal discovery algorithm family that compares configurations across benchmarks, showing specific improvements in directed F1 scores over established methods.

item.title: [paper] EgoCaptioner: Towards Comprehensive and Fine-Grained Egocentric Video Captioning
item.description: Egocentric video captioning requires fine-grained detail and accurate timing, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss brief actions, confuse their order, or misinterpret the wearer's motion.

item.title: [paper] From Benchmarks to the Bench: Preference, Correspondence and Selectivity in Bidirectional Drug-Target Screening
item.description: Comparative evaluation of thirteen drug-target interaction systems showing that model predictions often lack consensus and vary in hit enrichment reliability.

item.title: [paper] Fast Self-Supervised Generative CT Denoising via Few-Step Sampling
item.description: Self-supervised generative CT denoising method that accelerates few-step sampling via improved mean flow to effectively suppress noise and preserve anatomical detail.

item.title: [news] Launch HN: Onlook (YC W25) – An open-source developer tool for designers
item.description: Onlook is an open-source desktop application that places a visual canvas over a codebase to let designers build and edit code using AI agents.

item.title: [paper] Contactless Estimation of Respiratory Frequency Using 3D-CNN on Thermal Images
item.description: Deep learning method using a 3D convolutional neural network on thermal videos to estimate respiratory frequency without complex pre-processing or region-of-tracking.

item.title: [paper] World Models Favor Learned Priors over Visual Evidence
item.description: Benchmark and rule inference method for evaluating and mitigating how world models incorrectly favor common physical rules over rare ones during cross-environment transfer.

item.title: [paper] HiSA: Sparsifying the Hidden Dimension of RoPE Attention in LLMs
item.description: Hidden sparse attention method for large language models that computes partial dot products along the hidden dimension to improve inference speed and memory footprint.

item.title: [paper] How Much Should an Agent Remember? Deployment Lessons from Self-Distilled Memory for LLM Agents
item.description: Open-source pipeline and deployment method that extracts short lessons from agent execution trajectories to generate guidelines for improving long-horizon task completion.

item.title: [paper] Learning from Context: Leave-One-Out Prediction in Jump Diffusions
item.description: Jump diffusion model variant using leave-one-out prediction that improves text and molecular graph generation metrics by predicting coordinates from other corrupted states.

item.title: [paper] Beam Model Technical Report
item.description: Sparse mixture-of-experts model optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads while requiring significantly less inference compute than comparable models.

item.title: [paper] Mamba Flow Matching Neural Processes: Linear-Time Inference for Irregularly Observed Spatial Fields
item.description: MambaFlowNP is a linear-time joint-predictive neural process trained with conditional flow matching that interpolates irregularly observed spatial fields efficiently.

item.title: [paper] TRCF: Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting for Irregular Multivariate Time Series
item.description: Temporal-Reference Complementary Forecasting is a framework that combines a channel-independent forecaster with a complementary channel-dependent branch to predict irregular multivariate time series.

item.title: [paper] Perfumer: A Large Language Model-based Agentic Framework Accelerating Structural Relaxation and Electronic Band Prediction for First-Principle Calculation
item.description: Perfumer is a large language model-based agentic framework that couples Quantum ESPRESSO with predictive models to accelerate structural relaxation and electronic band predictions.

item.title: [paper] OffBeat: Multicoset Sampling for 4D Capture Beyond the Camera Frame Rate
item.description: OffBeat is a multicoset sampling method that models staggered camera rigs to achieve high-quality 4D capture and reconstruction beyond the camera frame rate.

item.title: [paper] Context as a Resource
item.description: ClonAct is a routerless architecture that virtualizes context blocks using a pluggable context memory management unit and synaptic bus to manage concurrent multi-stream tasks efficiently.

item.title: [paper] DeepQuest: From Knowledge Gaps to Scientific Discovery in Alzheimer's Disease
item.description: DeepQuest is an AI scientist framework that transforms literature reviews into testable hypotheses and generates traceable research findings for Alzheimer's disease.

item.title: [paper] Training LLMs to Follow Reasoning Instructions with Minimal Edits
item.description: Edit-based training is a method that improves large language model reasoning instruction-following by supervising the model exclusively on localized textual corrections of its failures.

item.title: [paper] Sirius-Tiamat: How Small Can a One-Pass Decision Encoder Get Before Its Decisions Change?
item.description: Analysis of the Laya decision encoder reveals how model compression techniques like rounding, pruning, and quantization alter its classification decisions and calibration.

item.title: [paper] One Framework to Diagnose Them All: A Stratified Benchmark for Bengali LLM Hallucination
item.description: Alikbachan is a stratified Bengali hallucination-detection benchmark and dataset that evaluates zero-shot language model judges and competition systems across multiple failure modes.

item.title: [paper] ClosureBench: A Benchmark for Reasoning under Closure Assumptions
item.description: ClosureBench is a benchmark that evaluates whether large language models correctly handle missing information under different closure assumptions.

item.title: [paper] Online Temporal Rotations for 2 Bit KV-Cache Quantization in Video Diffusion Transformers
item.description: Temporal Rotation Quantization is a 2-bit KV-cache quantization method for video diffusion transformers that fits orthogonal transforms online to reduce quantization error and improve subject consistency in long video generation.

item.title: [paper] OceanCoder: A Verification-Guided Large Language Model for Automated Simulation Modelling in Ocean Engineering
item.description: OceanCoder is a verification-guided large language model that uses a three-layer verification framework and graded rewards to automate simulation modelling and code generation for ocean engineering tasks.

item.title: [paper] Rigel-Ladon: An Option-Count Law for a One-Pass Decision Encoder, Tested on Held-Out Option Counts and Held-Out Schemas
item.description: Study on the accuracy of a single-pass decision encoder reveals a log-linear relationship between logit accuracy and the number of available options as choice sets grow.

item.title: [paper] Conformal Selection for Hierarchical Streaming Data
item.description: Online Hierarchical Selection is a distribution-free method that constructs rank-based e-values for hierarchical data streams to perform online candidate selection while controlling the false discovery rate.

item.title: [paper] Predicting Surface Displacement Fields of Laser Powder Bed Fusion Parts Using STL-Derived Graphs and Part-Level Descriptors
item.description: Two-branch graph attention network predicts three-dimensional surface displacement and manufacturing distortion from STL-derived meshes and part-level descriptors for laser powder bed fusion parts.

item.title: [paper] FirstCross: Convex Single-Photon 3D Reconstruction from Sparse Views
item.description: FirstCross is a network-free 3D reconstruction approach that solves convex problems on a voxel grid using first-crossing photon arrival times to achieve high depth accuracy from sparse views and low photon flux.

item.title: [paper] A Control-Theoretic Approximation to Predictive Coding Dynamics
item.description: Deep feedback control serves as a control-theoretic local approximation to predictive coding dynamics near fixed points, offering a biologically plausible alternative for training neural networks.

item.title: [paper] ResVision: Spectrum-Matched Resizing and Context-Preserving Inspection for Visual Reasoning
item.description: ResVision combines spectrum-matched resizing and context-preserving inspection to improve visual reasoning in vision-language models by dynamically allocating visual tokens and retaining global context alongside local crops.

item.title: [paper] Language-Oriented Semantic Modeling for Target Language Extraction
item.description: Language-oriented semantic modeling framework integrates language-aware semantic representations derived from a pre-trained speech model into acoustic extraction to improve target language isolation from multilingual speech mixtures.

item.title: [paper] C-LiTE: A Lightweight Foundation Model for Cellular feature learning in Histopathology
item.description: C-LiTE is a lightweight 22-million parameter foundation model utilizing native-resolution tokenisation to learn cellular representations from histopathology image crops for tasks like tumour grading and immune profiling.

item.title: [paper] Actor-Predictor Architecture for Reinforcement Learning with Formal Specification Objectives
item.description: Actor-Predictor is a reinforcement learning framework that uses a learned surrogate representation to satisfy formal specification objectives without constructing an automaton, outperforming baselines on robotic tasks.

item.title: [paper] Client Exits - A Way to Increase LLM Transparency on the Client Side
item.description: Client Exits is a lightweight mechanism that allows large language models to insert machine-interpretable markers into outputs, enabling clients to customize how supplementary information is presented.

item.title: [paper] Scalable fault vulnerability analysis for ReRAM-based process-in-memory CNN accelerators
item.description: A scalable analytical framework quantifies permanent fault vulnerabilities in convolutional neural networks deployed on resistive random-access memory PIM accelerators without requiring exhaustive simulations.

item.title: [paper] A Tensor-Algebraic No-Go Theorem for High-Dimensional Photonic Greenberger--Horne--Zeilinger States Discovered with AlphaProof Nexus
item.description: AlphaProof Nexus assisted in discovering a tensor-algebraic no-go theorem proving that no complex-weighted monochromatic quantum graph exists for even photon numbers and high dimensions.

item.title: [paper] SKILL.PNG: Learning Agent Skills in Pixel Space
item.description: Skill.png optimizes image-space agent skills via gradient descent through a frozen vision-language model encoder, improving performance and transferability while using fewer tokens than textual skills.

item.title: [paper] BADAS-3.0: Real-Time Driving Perception and Planning from One Camera
item.description: BADAS-3.0 is a 1B-parameter video encoder model that predicts vehicle speed, path, collision risk, and candidate futures from a single camera in real time.

item.title: [paper] Who Moved My $Z$ Boson? Revealing Resonance Features Inside a Neural Network
item.description: Mechanistic interpretability methods reveal that a generative collider physics model trained on unlabeled data contains internal features representing specific particle resonances that can be modified.

item.title: [paper] Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
item.description: An analysis of peer review data shows that review critique overlap has risen across major conferences and journals, with LLM-flagged reviews displaying higher homogenization than unflagged ones.

item.title: [paper] What If Chain-of-Thought Is Not Enough?
item.description: Training language models to use a structured decision process called Question-Option-Criteria instead of standard Chain-of-Thought improves answer quality and internal consistency.

item.title: [paper] dLoop: Looped Diffusion Language Models via Recurrent Latent Refinement
item.description: dLoop restructures pretrained diffusion language models into a looped architecture that recurrently refines latent representations before token commitment, improving accuracy across reasoning benchmarks.

item.title: [paper] Tracking Objects Through Assembly and Decomposition
item.description: Atlas is a zero-shot video tracking system that jointly reasons over forward and reverse spatiotemporal partitions to recover object tracks and detect both decomposition and assembly events.

item.title: [paper] A Statistical Framework for Training Data Auditing of Large Language Models
item.description: This paper proposes a unified statistical framework for document-level membership inference, target-collection global auditing, and suspicious-subset identification in large language models.

item.title: [paper] Digitization of Analogue Gauges using Computer Vision
item.description: This research develops and evaluates an automated analogue gauge reading system using computer vision and deep learning, finding that the ResNet18 architecture achieves an accuracy of 97.3%.

item.title: [paper] Similarity-based OSF Logic for Flexible SPARQL Query Answering
item.description: This paper introduces an updated version of fosf, a reasoner for fuzzy order-sorted feature logic, with support for flexible SPARQL query answering over RDF knowledge graphs.

item.title: [paper] SkillBridge: Cost-Aware Diagnosis and Repair of Cross-OS Compatibility Defects in Agent Skills
item.description: SkillBridge is a contract-based workflow that uses static analysis, dynamic validation, and repair to cost-effectively diagnose and fix cross-OS compatibility defects in agent skills.

item.title: [paper] STAGE: Spatio-Temporal Augmented Graph Expansion for Weakly Supervised Cross-Tweet Event Causality Discovery
item.description: STAGE is a framework that combines weak-supervision construction with spatio-temporal relational learning over event occurrences to discover causal relations across independent social media posts.

item.title: [paper] Prism: Hierarchical Text Detection with Minimalist Design
item.description: Prism is a minimalist framework for hierarchical text detection that uses a single-scale backbone and parallel lightweight heads to localize words, text lines, and paragraphs with high efficiency.

item.title: [paper] The Stability Gap in Continual Reinforcement Learning
item.description: This paper introduces a continual reinforcement learning benchmark and demonstrates the stability gap, which is a temporary drop in prior-task performance after new tasks are introduced.

item.title: [paper] Beyond Covers and Titles: Evidence-First Ranking for Robust Cold-Start Recommendation
item.description: Evidence-First Ranking is a ranking method that scores cold videos from their body and uses a bounded support-gated residual to defend against packaging edits on short-video platforms.

item.title: [paper] TwinLab-Bench: Evaluating AI Scientists in Agentic Twins of Real Labs
item.description: TwinLab-Bench is a benchmark for evaluating AI scientists on self-designed experiments across 52 tasks from physical science, life science, and engineering laboratories.

item.title: [paper] FastRoverVLA: Fast Vision-Language-Action Execution for Off-Road Autonomous Driving
item.description: FastRoverVLA is a training-free interface for off-road vision-language-action models that decouples visual plan generation from motion-conditioned execution to reduce inference costs and trajectory errors.

item.title: [paper] Physics-Informed Feature Representations and Pretrained Tabular Foundation Models for Generalizable Melt Pool Geometry Prediction
item.description: Physics-informed dimensionless features combined with pretrained tabular foundation models improve generalizable melt pool width, depth, and melting mode predictions in advanced manufacturing.

item.title: [paper] Attention Drift Regularization with Adaptive Initialization for Domain-Robust Visual Recognition
item.description: DGA-CAFC is a domain-robust visual recognition method that uses counterfactual attention consistency and domain-gap-aware source model selection to prevent attention drift and stabilize pseudo-label quality.

item.title: [paper] Time Series Structure Learning with Local Causal Parent Discovery
item.description: Iterative Temporal Parent Discovery is a sound and complete constraint-based procedure for causal structure learning on multivariate time series with causal nonstationarity.

item.title: [paper] Attention Head Specialization: Phase Transitions in Sample Complexity
item.description: Phase transitions in sample complexity explain how attention heads specialize during training as a function of available dataset size.

item.title: [paper] Sightline: Calibrated Data-Flow Summaries for LLM-Integrated Applications
item.description: Sightline is a calibrated data-flow summarization tool for LLM-integrated applications that tracks prompt placeholders to model outputs using attention patterns and log-probability gradients.

item.title: [paper] MixReact: Physics-Based Reactive Humanoid Control from Multimodal Cues via a Discrete-Continuous Mixture of Transformers
item.description: MixReact is a physics-based reactive humanoid control framework that uses a mixture of transformers to generate physical behaviors from text, audio, and video cues.
